shots.line: Under the northern lights, 68 startups stand across Helsinki, and 8 of them are hiring tonight.
At Töölönlahdenkatu 2, Verda operates data centres and GPU hardware for training AI models, backed by a 189 million dollar Series B.
Over at Lapinlahdenkatu 16, Saidot builds an AI governance platform to map risks, policies, and compliance.
Aiforia Technologies, a University of Helsinki spin-off at Pursimiehenkatu 29, provides cloud software for medical image analysis.
By the harbour at Henry Fordin katu 6, ReOrbit employs 126 people building sovereign satellites and software for national security.
From business software to climate and gaming, the map of Helsinki is open to explore.
